name: @schoolos/ocs
description: SchoolOS Open Course Specification (roadmap §5.3 and §15.10, PR C06): the OCS course package contract (manifest, units, activities, resources, Codex, lockfile), a deterministic module resolver, the composer that flattens a locked course into one outline, friendly composition for teachers, and the export to curriculum activity installations. A library, not a deployable Worker. See docs/schoolos/rfc/0001-open-course-specification.md.
